title: Zoom through
summary: The camera dives through A and lands on B.
signature: zoomThrough(a, b, p, { scale, origin, curve })

params.name: scale
params.description: how far the camera dives (scale at the end)

notes: The camera dives through A (scaling past the lens) and lands on B. `origin` is where the camera dives in (put it on the subject, e.g. '30% 50%'). B lands from slightly larger, so no edge shows.
At p = 0 only A shows, at p = 1 only B; keep B above A (z-index).
